Cyberattack Targets Major Global Websites, Affecting Services

Multiple prominent websites, including the BBC, HSBC UAE, Air France, and Zoom, were reportedly infected with malicious code. The attack targeted payment cards and Apple devices, leading to reported outages affecting Apple Pay and iCloud services. The specific nature and origin of the cyberattack remain unspecified in the coverage.
